title: Substrate removal efficiency of a facultative aerated lagoon by the dispersed flow model
readable: S/S0 = 4a·e^(1/2d) / ((1+a)² e^(a/2d) − (1−a)² e^(−a/2d));  a = SQRT(1 + 4Kθd);  d: dispersion number (dimensionless) = D/UL = Dθ/L²

symbols.definition: dispersion number (dimensionless), printed as = D/UL = Dθ/L²

applicability: Relation between influent and effluent substrate concentrations S0 and S for facultative aerated lagoons, in which treatability of the waste, temperature and mixing conditions are taken into account; solved graphically in Figure 5.41.
notes: Exponents are printed as 1/2d, a/2d and −a/2d (not 1/(2d)); preserved as printed.
The printed inline term line reads "in which the term  a = √1 + 4Kθd"; the radical bar was checked at 8x zoom and covers the whole 1 + 4Kθd.
The d line is printed on two lines: "d: dispersion number (dimensionless)" and "= D/UL = Dθ/ L²".
Symbol θ is printed as a lower-case theta in the equation and in the symbol list; the printed list shows Dθ/L² with a capital theta glyph.

transcription.method: direct visual reading of 144 dpi annotation-cleaned full-page renders plus 288-900 dpi crops of the source regions; no OCR
